spreadsheetRows: Open the destination and confirm it still resolves to the intended product.
Record the current color, size, quantity and option text—not only the product title.
Keep item price, seller domestic shipping and optional product services in separate fields.
Record the standard QC result, measurements requested and any visible mismatch.
Track warehouse arrival against the current 90-day free-storage window.
Group only items that make sense together after weight, dimensions and restrictions are known.
Use a clear status: review, buy, awaiting warehouse, request evidence, return, parcel or closed.
guideRows: Paste or open the current product route, choose the exact option and pay the item price plus domestic delivery shown.
Superbuy's shopping agent contacts the seller and purchases the submitted item; missing information can be requested by message or email.
After arrival, the item is inspected and photographed. The current homepage states that three free QC photos are provided.
The official guide currently gives 90 days of free storage, allowing more items to arrive before a parcel is created.
Select eligible warehouse items, enter the destination and compare the lines shown for that actual parcel.
Pay the international shipping deposit; the final fee is adjusted after the carrier verifies package size and weight.
qcRows: Match item type, model, color, quantity, size label and visible option before judging small details.
The current Superbuy homepage states that three free QC photos are taken after warehouse receipt.
Compare warehouse measurements with a familiar item measured at the same points; labels alone are not enough.
Inspect alignment, seams, print, hardware, soles, stains, damage and pair consistency where relevant.
Request a focused detailed photo only when one missing view or measurement could change the decision.
Photos cannot prove authenticity, internal quality, composition, comfort or durability; 1688 uses a different QC standard.
shippingRows: Keep item and domestic-delivery costs separate from the international parcel charge.
The deposit uses estimated weight, selected route and destination; final size and weight can create an account adjustment.
Compare actual and volumetric weight because light, bulky parcels may be priced by space.
Superbuy states that eligible warehouse orders can be consolidated for free, but one large parcel is not always cheapest.
Package removal, reinforcement and insurance are optional tools; select them according to the parcel's risk.
Available lines depend on destination, item attributes, weight, dimensions and current carrier conditions.
Tariffs, VAT, declarations and import restrictions are destination-specific; no sheet can promise tax-free delivery.
faqRows: What is a Superbuy spreadsheet?
An independent product-research index that records current routes, selected options, price references, QC questions and parcel decisions.
Does Superbuy charge a purchasing service fee?
Its current fee page says standard purchasing is free on mainstream platforms such as Taobao, Tmall, JD.com and 1688. Special, second-hand and optional services use separate rules.
Are displayed prices final?
No. USD amounts are references. Confirm the live option, item price, domestic delivery and selected services before paying.
Does a checked link mean verified quality?
No. A checked route confirms only that the destination was reviewed. Quality decisions require warehouse evidence and still have limits.
How many free QC photos are provided?
The current Superbuy homepage states that three free QC photos are taken after warehouse receipt.
How long is free storage?
The current fee page states 90 days free. It also lists a per-item daily fee after that window and a standard maximum storage period of 180 days.
Can I combine different orders?
Superbuy states that eligible stored items can be consolidated into one parcel for free. Whether it saves money depends on size, weight, restrictions and available lines.
Why can the shipping deposit change?
The deposit uses estimated weight, route and destination. Final shipping is recalculated after the carrier verifies package size and weight.
Can QC photos prove authenticity or fit?
No. They can document visible facts but cannot reliably prove authenticity, material composition, comfort, durability or fit.
Is this the official platform?
No. This independent research resource does not sell products, process payments or handle shipping. Always confirm current rules in your account before acting.
